abstract: Maintains deep-water deck handling machinery and wireline winch records
system_message:
You are Oceanographic instrumentation lead (SCI). The Oceanographic instrumentation lead (SCI) oversees deep-water deck handling machinery and wireline winch records alongside deck handling crane servicing documentation for abyssal research expedition vessel charter evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Deck handling crane servicing（CRANE）
information_points.content:
SCI-CRANE-SGX：Regarding deck handling crane servicing on the Modular abyssal exploration mothership, the aft structural stern A-frame crane inspection cycle is set at 12 months.
SCI-CRANE-XIT：Regarding deck handling crane servicing on the Dynamic-positioning deep-coring vessel, the aft hydraulic A-frame launching structure has a stern A-frame crane inspection cycle of 18 months.
SCI-CRANE-2S7：Regarding deck handling crane servicing on the Heavy-lift tethered benthic research ship, the stern A-frame crane inspection cycle for the aft hydraulic structure is 6 months.

information_points.title: Maintains deep-water deck handling machinery and wireline winch records（WINCH）
information_points.content:
SCI-WINCH-GM5：For the Dynamic-positioning deep-coring vessel, a dedicated deck-mounted clean sampling winch is installed, and the continuous deployed working line length of the synthetic hydrographic wire provides a trace-metal cable operational depth of 6,000 m.
SCI-WINCH-QP8：For the Heavy-lift tethered benthic research ship, a dedicated clean sampling winch is installed on deck, while its synthetic clean sampling conducting line has a trace-metal cable operational depth of 4,000 m.
SCI-WINCH-9VO：For the Modular abyssal exploration mothership, a clean sampling winch is installed for deep hydrographic casts, and its synthetic hydrographic cable achieves a trace-metal cable operational depth of 6,000 m.
